review.title: Outbreak alert review
review.intro: A draft alert is created when 3 or more photos show the same disease in one division within 7 days. No farmer sees it unless you approve it.
review.emptyHint: Drafts appear here when farmers' photos meet the rule.
review.approveBody: After approval, farmers in this division see it labelled 'possible outbreak, unverified'. The decision is written to the audit log.
review.rejectBody: Farmers will not see it. The decision is written to the audit log.

trust.title: Trust Centre
trust.intro: What Kakatarua knows, where it comes from, and what it does not know.

honesty.h1: We did not train the disease model; Meta's Llama 4 vision model is used. No accuracy figure has been measured yet.
honesty.h2: When confidence is low the app says 'not sure' instead of guessing.
honesty.h3: Advice comes only from BRRI factsheets and every step shows its source. No agronomist has reviewed it yet.
honesty.h4: Until the official banned-pesticide list is sourced, no chemical name or dose is ever given.
honesty.h5: Outbreak alerts never reach farmers unless a human reviewer approves them.
honesty.h6: All demo data is labelled DEMO DATA.
